scenarios.title: Propagare l’alimentazione commutata ai rami lampada e LED
scenarios.hypothesis: After closing switch25.1, the battery voltage reaches N002 but does not propagate to the branch input nodes N003 and N004; feeding both from N002 should energize the LED and lamp branches together.
